# finla

> Turkey's first chat-native e-invoice assistant. An AI-powered, conversation-based e-Fatura and e-Arşiv assistant for freelancers and SMEs (KOBİs) in Turkey.

finla lets you issue GİB-compliant e-Fatura / e-Arşiv invoices in natural Turkish chat—no forms or menus—reply to incoming invoices, and export reports to Excel. Invoices are finalized through a GİB-approved e-document integrator.

## Product

- [finla homepage](https://www.heyfinla.com/): Product overview, features, security, audience, and FAQ (Turkish landing page)
- [Full product brief (llms-full)](https://www.heyfinla.com/llms-full.txt): Same facts as the landing, in one file for AI agents

## Sections

- [Features](https://www.heyfinla.com/#ozellikler): Chat invoicing, inbox, tax logic, FX, Excel reports, live streaming replies
- [How it works](https://www.heyfinla.com/#nasil-calisir): Write → finla prepares → submit to GİB
- [Security](https://www.heyfinla.com/#guvenlik): Encrypted credential vault, Face ID, PIN, on-device session, KVKK
- [Technology](https://www.heyfinla.com/#teknoloji): Tool-using invoice agent, GİB-approved integrator
- [Who it's for](https://www.heyfinla.com/#kimler-icin): Freelancers, SME owners, e-commerce sellers
- [FAQ](https://www.heyfinla.com/#sss): Official invoices, e-Fatura/e-Arşiv, VAT (KDV), FX, security, accountant
